from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section1Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Prerequisites: The Vector Space Concept", ["Words are converted into numerical vectors.", "Similar meanings cluster in space.", "Cat and Dog are close."])
        
        # --- Create objects ---
        # Note: Using Axes instead of NumberPlane for better control per instructions B045
        axes = Axes(x_range=[-3, 3], y_range=[-3, 3], x_length=5, y_length=5, axis_config={"include_tip": True}).scale(0.8)
        grid_label = Text("Vector Space", font_size=24, color='#FFFFFF')
        self.place_in_area(grid_label, 'A2', 'A5', scale_factor=1.0)
        
        # Assets
        cat_icon = ImageMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cat.png")
        dog_icon = SVGMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/dog.svg")
        
        v = Vector([1.5, 1], color='#FF00FF')
        v_label = MathTex("v", color='#FF00FF')
        self.place_at_grid(v_label, 'C4', scale_factor=0.8)
        
        u = Vector([-0.5, 1.5], color='#FFFF00')
        u_label = MathTex("u", color='#FFFF00')
        self.place_at_grid(u_label, 'C2', scale_factor=0.8)
        
        v_plus_u = MathTex("v+u", color='#00FFFF')
        self.place_in_area(v_plus_u, 'A3', 'A4', scale_factor=0.9)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(FadeIn(axes))
        self.add(grid_label)
        self.place_in_area(cat_icon, 'D4', 'E5', scale_factor=0.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(cat_icon))
        self.lecture[0].set_color('#FFFFFF')
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(Create(v), Write(v_label))
        self.lecture[0].set_color('#808080')
        self.lecture[1].set_color('#FF00FF')
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(Create(u), Write(u_label))
        self.play(Write(v_plus_u))
        self.place_in_area(dog_icon, 'D2', 'E3', scale_factor=0.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(dog_icon))
        self.lecture[1].set_color('#808080')
        self.lecture[2].set_color('#00FFFF')
        self.wait(2)

class Section2Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        lecture_lines = ["Self-attention weights word importance.", "Words connect with varying strength.", "'It' connects strongly to 'animal'."]
        self.setup_layout("The Transformer Core: Self-Attention Mechanism", lecture_lines)
        
        # --- Preparation ---
        formula = MathTex(r"Attention(Q, K, V) = softmax\left(\frac{QK^T}{\sqrt{d_k}}\right)V", font_size=32, color=WHITE)
        animal_icon = SVGMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/animal.svg")
        
        # Place formula and icon in defined area
        group = VGroup(formula, animal_icon).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.3)
        self.place_in_area(group, 'A3', 'B5', scale_factor=0.8)

        # Matrices representation
        q_label = Text("Q", font_size=24, color=WHITE)
        k_label = Text("K", font_size=24, color=WHITE)
        v_label = Text("V", font_size=24, color=WHITE)
        matrices = VGroup(q_label, k_label, v_label).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.5)
        self.place_in_area(matrices, 'C2', 'C5', scale_factor=0.8)
        
        # Heatmap area
        heatmap = Square(side_length=2.0, color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.3)
        self.place_in_area(heatmap, 'D3', 'F5', scale_factor=0.8)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(Write(formula), FadeIn(animal_icon))
        self.lecture[0].set_color("#00FFFF")
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(FadeIn(matrices))
        self.play(matrices.animate.set_color("#FFD700"), run_time=0.5)
        self.play(matrices.animate.set_color(WHITE), run_time=0.5)
        self.lecture[1].set_color("#FFD700")
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(heatmap.animate.set_color("#FF0000"))
        self.lecture[2].set_color("#FF0000")
        self.wait(2)

class Section3Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Scaling Up: From Transformer to LLM", 
                          ["Stacking blocks deepens linguistic patterns.", 
                           "Models shift to complex reasoning.", 
                           "Large models grasp context 'essence'."])
        
        # Define visual elements using the asset
        block_path = "/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/blocks.svg"
        blocks_group = VGroup(*[SVGMobject(block_path) for _ in range(5)])
        blocks_group.arrange(DOWN, buff=0.1)
        
        # Initial placement as per criticism (Issue 23/31)
        self.place_in_area(blocks_group, 'C4', 'F5', scale_factor=0.5)
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Show stacked blocks in #FFFFFF
        for b in blocks_group:
            b.set_color(WHITE)
        self.play(FadeIn(blocks_group))
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(WHITE))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Pulse a layer in #00FF00
        pulse_layer = blocks_group[2].copy().set_color("#00FF00")
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color("#00FF00"))
        self.play(Indicate(pulse_layer, color="#00FF00"))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Animate weights updating in #FF4500
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color("#FF4500"))
        
        # Particle visualization as per criticism (Issue 24/31)
        particles = VGroup(*[Dot(radius=0.05, color="#FF4500") for _ in range(20)])
        self.place_in_area(particles, 'C4', 'F5', scale_factor=0.4)
        
        # Label as per criticism (Issue 25/31)
        label_text = Text("Weights Updating", font_size=20, color="#FF4500")
        self.place_at_grid(label_text, 'D3', scale_factor=0.6)
        
        self.add(particles, label_text)
        self.play(particles.animate.shift(UP*0.2), run_time=1.5)
        self.wait(2)

class Section4Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.setup_layout("Application: The Probabilistic Prediction Engine", 
                          ["LLMs predict the next token.", "Probabilities depend on prior context.", "'The' suggests 'cat' or 'car'."])
        
        # Prep assets
        cat_icon = ImageMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cat.png")
        car_icon = ImageMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/car.png")
        
        # Prep objects
        dist_bars = VGroup(*[Rectangle(height=1.5 * (0.8**i), width=0.8, color="#FFFFFF", fill_opacity=0.7) for i in range(5)])
        dist_bars.arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.2)
        
        picked_token = Text("cat", color="#FFFF00")
        next_word = Text("The cat", color="#800080")
        
        # Apply positioning constraints
        self.place_in_area(dist_bars, "B2", "B5", scale_factor=0.6)
        self.place_at_grid(picked_token, "D2", scale_factor=0.7)
        self.place_at_grid(next_word, "D5", scale_factor=0.7)
        self.place_at_grid(cat_icon, "C3", scale_factor=0.2)
        self.place_at_grid(car_icon, "C4", scale_factor=0.2)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color("#FFFFFF")
        self.play(Create(dist_bars), FadeIn(cat_icon), FadeIn(car_icon))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.lecture[1].set_color("#FFFF00")
        self.play(Indicate(dist_bars[0]), FadeIn(picked_token))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.lecture[2].set_color("#800080")
        self.play(ReplacementTransform(picked_token, next_word))
        self.wait(1)

outline.topic: Large Language Models and the Transformer Architecture
outline.target_audience: University students with a basic background in computer science

sections.title: Prerequisites: The Vector Space Concept
sections.content: Briefly define how computers represent words as lists of numbers (Word Embeddings). Explain that words with similar meanings occupy nearby coordinates in a multi-dimensional 'meaning space'.
sections.example: Visualizing 'Cat', 'Dog', and 'Toaster' as points; Cat and Dog are close together, while Toaster is in a distant corner of the map.

sections.title: The Transformer Core: Self-Attention Mechanism
sections.content: Introduce the concept of 'Attention' as a way to weight the importance of different words in a sentence relative to one another. Visualize this as dynamic lines connecting words, where thicker lines represent stronger relationships.
sections.example: In the sentence 'The animal didn't cross the street because it was too tired', animate the word 'it' drawing a thick connection line to 'animal' rather than 'street'.

sections.title: Scaling Up: From Transformer to LLM
sections.content: Explain how stacking many Transformer blocks creates a Deep Learning model capable of identifying complex linguistic patterns, shifting from simple word prediction to reasoning.
sections.example: Imagine a chef following a recipe; a small model is a novice cook, while a Large Language Model is an executive chef who understands the 'essence' of the flavors (context).

sections.title: Application: The Probabilistic Prediction Engine
sections.content: Conclude by demonstrating how an LLM acts as an 'autocomplete' machine on steroids. It predicts the probability of the next token based on all previous tokens.
sections.example: A robot librarian suggesting the next word in a sentence: Given 'The', it suggests 'cat' (high probability) or 'car' (lower probability) based on the context of the preceding paragraph.
